features.name: DMFT repo governance and protected master flow
acceptance_tests: CI workflow runs on pull requests into master, pushes to master, and manual dispatch
Required PR gate is the self-hosted Windows `PR gate (fmt + clippy + test + python)` and still runs on README-only and docs-only changes
README Metrics workflow no longer pushes directly to protected master and bootstraps the nightly Windows Rust toolchain it actually needs
Nightly Release, Release, and Wiki Nightly workflows are hardened for the self-hosted Windows runner without depending on runner-local pwsh or preinstalled toolchains
DMFT PR manager automation runs every 5 hours against the DMFT repository checkout on the automation host
python3 scripts/sync_wiki.py --check
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test
features.notes: DMFT now documents master as the protected release branch, uses the self-hosted Windows PR gate as the only required merge check, keeps release/nightly/wiki automation out of merge blocking, hardens the self-hosted Windows workflows around cmd-safe gates, pinned CMake setup, git safe.directory bootstrapping, and nightly rustup provisioning, and tracks the scheduled DMFT PR manager automation that opens, updates, and merges PRs for agent-authored branches.

features.name: Codex-first autonomous issue pipeline
acceptance_tests: Issue template captures Scope, Done when, Verify, Out of scope, and Source docs
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md define the shared autonomous worker contract
Codex issue executor automation is installed on the automation host and claims exactly one eligible issue per run
DMFT PR manager automation requires merge:auto and refuses human:required, risk:high, or agent:blocked merges
Trusted agent PRs default `merge:auto` unless the PR or linked issue is explicitly blocked by labels
DMFT PR manager can auto-close stale or superseded trusted agent PRs with a reason comment
Optional Claude GitHub Action only responds to worker:claude or @claude and never merges

features.notes: Repo docs, issue template, worker contract, Claude workflow, and Codex automation files now define the autonomous queue. The installed issue executor currently runs hourly because Codex app automations do not yet support 15-minute cadences. Trusted agent PRs now default `merge:auto` unless explicitly blocked, and the PR manager is allowed to resolve addressed bot threads plus close stale or superseded agent PRs. The `DMFT Roadmap` project now uses a dedicated `Agent Status` field for queue state so the built-in `Status` field can keep its broader roadmap-progress meaning.
